text:
Maya: Quick sync on next Wed webinar — final checklist: reg page, consent language, Zoom RTMP fallback, captioning vendor, and lead routing to HubSpot.

Jamie: Sounds good. HubSpot native form preferred for contact mapping, but Typeform had nicer timezone handling last time. Any preference?

Maya: HubSpot wins for attribution. Add a small timezone selector (PST/EST/CET/APAC) so we can schedule follow-ups correctly.

Trevor: Mapping is easy. Add a HubSpot property 'timezone_preference' with those values. Also we'll tag source=webinar-2026-q2 and utm params.

Li: RTMP fallback plan: run primary on Zoom webinar, stream RTMP concurrently to our vendor. If Zoom stream drops, vendor keeps recording and we switch playback to vendor recording.

Jamie: Can we get an automated Slack alert when vendor becomes the active source? That helps comms.

Li: Yep. Zoom webhook -> small Lambda -> post to #marketing with event type. Pseudocode:
```
if (event === 'webinar.streaming.failed') post('#marketing','RTMP fallback active: '+details)
```

Maya: Important: legal requires explicit consent for recording and reuse. Add a required checkbox: "I consent to recording and transcript use for marketing and product improvement" (not pre-checked).

Trevor: Will add that field and a GDPR opt-out for EU registrants. Also enable anonymized IP collection for EU.

Jamie: Recording -> S3 raw -> auto-transcode -> captions to Rev.ai -> merge captions -> generate clips (00:30, 01:00, 03:00) -> deliver to Growth for ads. Workflow script is in the runbook.

Maya: Rehearsal set for Tue 10:00 PT. Speakers: Maya, Rahul, Dana. Dana please upload final slides by Mon EOD to the shared drive.

Dana: Uploaded slides v3 at https://drive.example/final-slides. I'll be on the rehearsal and will test screen sharing flow.

Maya: Great. Also we want a 1-question poll mid-session: "Are you currently evaluating inference infra?" Map results back to a contact property for SDR segmentation.

Jamie: We'll add the poll to the run deck and a moderator script line to push attendees to answer. Pull responses via Zoom API to HubSpot.

Trevor: HubSpot/Zapier mapping: form submit -> create contact -> add to list 'webinar-2026-q2-registrants' -> send DM to #marketing-ops -> set initial workflow for reminder emails.

Maya: Reminder cadence: Confirmation on sign-up, reminder 48h out, 1h out, and 15m push. Post-event: send transcript + replay within 48 hours.

Li: Infra preflight 30m prior: encoder health check, outbound bandwidth test, regional failover sanity. I'll post the checklist in channel 30m out.

Jamie: Captioning: we use Rev.ai for ASR. Ensure we capture speaker labels and request manual QC for keynote segments before publishing.

Trevor: For engagement routing: flag viewers with >50% watch-time and poll=yes for SDR follow-up label 'high-intent'. We'll export to Growth queue.

Maya: All right — legal + ops + growth owners noted. If anything blocks, ping me directly. Thanks everyone :tada:
